Container.Name: feedstash
Container.Overview: Self-hosted feed reader and read-it-later stash. Follow RSS and Atom feeds in folders, and save links, snippets and screenshots from the browser, email or your phone. Sign in with a password, Google, or any OpenID Connect provider such as Pocket ID or Authentik, set up in Settings after install.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the web app is served on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and uploaded images. Use a pool path like /mnt/cache/appdata/feedstash rather than /mnt/user/appdata: SQLite doesn't like the /mnt/user FUSE layer.

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: The address you open FeedStash at, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8672. Use both if you also reach it through a reverse proxy, comma separated, proxy first: https://feedstash.example.com,http://192.168.1.10:8672

Config.Name: PASSWORD_LOGIN
Config.Description: Accounts with a FeedStash password. The first visit asks you to create the admin account.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: REFRESH_INTERVAL_MINUTES
Config.Description: How often feeds are fetched (5 or more).

Config.Name: RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: Feed articles older than this are deleted (starred ones and the newest 50 per feed are kept).

Config.Name: PAGE_CAPTURE
Config.Description: Fetch the page behind each saved link (and full articles for feeds that ask) for previews, readable copies and full-text search.

Config.Name: SESSION_DAYS
Config.Description: How long you stay signed in.

Config.Name: MAIL_POLL_MINUTES
Config.Description: How often a mailbox connected under Settings, Email is checked.

Config.Name: FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS
Config.Description: Addresses whose X-Forwarded-* headers are trusted: private networks, where a reverse proxy normally runs. Only change it if your proxy reaches FeedStash from a public address; never use *.

Config.Name: SETUP_TOKEN
Config.Description: First-run setup only works from your own network. To set up from anywhere else, set a token here and enter it on the setup page. You can remove it once your account exists.

Config.Name: LOG_REQUESTS
Config.Description: Which requests get a line in the log (in /data/logs) until you change it in Settings, Logs: changes (saves, edits and failures), errors, all (every request) or none.

Config.Name: UPDATE_CHECK
Config.Description: Once a day, while an admin has FeedStash open, ask GitHub whether a newer release is out, so the sidebar can say so. false turns it off.
